title: As Trump Politicizes Justice Dept., Prosecutors Struggle With Grand Juries
partialText: Judges and grand juries have increasingly lost faith in the Justice Department as the president uses it to reward his friends and go after his opponents.

title: UFC Unveils Plans for White House Fight on Trump’s Birthday
partialText: The Ultimate Fighting Championship bout is scheduled for June 14, President Trump’s 80th birthday.

title: Trump Declares Himself in Good Health After Physical Exam at Walter Reed
partialText: President Trump, who will turn 80 next month, did not give details on the exam.

title: The Wars in Ukraine and Iran Are More Alike Than You May Think
partialText: Aspects such as drone technology and diplomacy show how the wars intersect on the battlefield and in global alignments, providing a model for future conflicts.

title: Iran Begins Lifting Monthslong Internet Blackout, Officials Say
partialText: Organizations that track online traffic confirmed an uptick in activity on Tuesday, as Iranians reconnected to the global internet after a government-imposed shutdown.

title: To Understand Pope Leo’s Efforts on A.I., Look at the Man Shaking His Hand
partialText: The co-founder of a prominent A.I. company was nearby as the pope implored A.I. leaders to slow down and consider the technology’s possible perils.

title: Scientists Ditched a Scary Climate Scenario. What Now?
partialText: While global warming is still a threat, the decision to back away from a worst-case outlook raises questions about whether some risks have been overstated.

title: A Spring Heat Wave is Breaking Records in the U.K., Spain and France
partialText: Authorities in Britain and France warned that “unprecedented” temperatures — at a time when few expected them — could persist. Climate change has made heat waves more frequent and more intense.

title: The Homesteading Mother of 6 Taking On Big Tech
partialText: Kassi Solberg has concerns about a proposed data center complex, the size of 3,800 football fields, near her home. Trust us, the developer says.

title: Court Rejects Alabama House Map, Calling It Unfair to Black Voters
partialText: Alabama is likely to appeal the ruling, which stops an effort to use a new congressional map that would likely cost Democrats a majority-Black district.

title: In the Georgia Governor’s Race, an Election Denier is the G.O.P. Front-Runner
partialText: Burt Jones, the leading G.O.P. candidate for governor, worked with Trump allies to try to overturn the election, and even talked to the president himself.

title: U.S. Aims to Give Cold War Plutonium to Start-Ups for Nuclear Fuel
partialText: Companies say it’s a better way to dispose of the Cold War-era material — and fix a shortage of nuclear fuel. But the plan has also faced criticism.

title: G.D.P. Is a Flawed Measure of Prosperity. Alternatives Are On the Way.
partialText: The United Nations has a new plan for weighing economic gains alongside health and environmental progress. But consensus is elusive.

title: Supreme Court Reverses Ruling in Immigration Judges’ Free Speech Lawsuit
partialText: A group of immigration judges in 2020 challenged work-related restrictions on their public speaking engagements, saying they violated their free speech rights.

title: SpaceX IPO Filing Reveals Favorable Terms for Elon Musk
partialText: The ways it set up its board and Mr. Musk’s pay appear to benefit him at the expense of other shareholders, corporate governance experts said.

title: The Average Guys Outsmarting Wall Street on Prediction Markets
partialText: How prediction-market ‘sharps’ have made millions wagering on everything from war to Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Celebrity Assistants Exist to Indulge Their Bosses, but When Does Duty Cross a Line?
partialText: Matthew Perry’s assistant injected the ketamine that killed his employer. His sentencing has some in the demanding profession considering the power dynamics involved.

title: ‘Armageddon’: The Blockbuster Melodrama That Left Our Heads Spinning

partialText: Iceland has stood apart from the rest of Europe. But President Trump’s threats to Greenland have provoked a reconsideration.

title: Judge to Decide How Long Torture’s Taint Infected the Sept. 11 Case
partialText: Eight days of legal arguments at Guantánamo have brought the long-running terrorism case to a moment of truth in the long wait for justice.

title: BP Ousts Chairman, Citing ‘Serious Concerns’ Over Conduct
partialText: The British oil group said that Albert Manifold had been removed, after concerns were raised “related to important governance standards, oversight and conduct.”
